2757-4687-7762.easyPrerequisites: Overgrowth attached to a basic land you control.
2757-4687-7762.description:
Activate the basic land with Overgrowth attached by tapping it, adding one mana.
Overgrowth triggers, adding two additional mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1999-2364-4613-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2364-4613-7340.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mana Vault from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

670-1619-6149-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6149-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Stirring Bard to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Stirring Bard trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Stirring Bard until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-7110-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7110-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Stormchaser's Talent and each creature you control that has prowess triggers.
Resolve all prowess triggers as applicable, giving those creatures +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Stormchaser's Talent trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1636-7110-7542.notes: As the Otters have prowess, they will trigger each loop after they are created.

2604-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

891-2730-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2374-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1062-3487-5436-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3487-5436-5674.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

678-4192-5659-5753-6798.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5659-5753-6798.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2034-2043-2557-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1737-2511-3621-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-2043-4050-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
1308-2043-4050-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

465-803-3480-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-3480-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4747-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Alena does not have summoning sickness. You had a creature with power 4 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Alena
4747-5200.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Alena.
Repeat.
4747-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Adrix and Nev

851-5361-5520.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
851-5361-5520.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability triggers, creating four token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Adrix and Nev attacking each other opponent.
When the Auton Soldier tokens enter the battlefield, Rose Room Treasurer triggers that many times.
Resolve the first two triggers, creating 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one) Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate any number of Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1} for each Treasure sacrificed this way.
Resolve the next Rose Room Treasurer trigger, choosing to pay {X} to deal X damage to any target.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 as desired for each remaining trigger.

293-388-2393-5220.description:
Activate Sanguine Spy by paying {1} and sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Sanguine Spy ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1329-1636-1778-4659.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1636-1778-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Memnite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Memnite enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2726-3362.notablePrerequisites: "Zombie" or "Dragon" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
2726-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Bladewing.
The Bladewing copy enters the battlefield, choose not to return a Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the original Bladewing.
Put the nontoken Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter the battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

1424-1491-5007.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling and Presence of Gond attached to Morselhoarder.
Morselhoarder does not have summoning sickness.
1424-1491-5007.description:
Activate Morselhoarder by tapping it to create 1/1 green Elf Warrior token.
Activate Sinking Feeling, by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Morselhoarder to untap it.
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it to add a mana of any color.
Repeat.

2428-3863-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Hard Cover attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
2428-3863-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card and discarding a card.
When you draw a card, Horizon Chimera will trigger, gaining you 1 life.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.
